meta.name: Island Assault — Kestrel Bay
meta.description: A task force holds a narrow western beachhead on Kestrel Island. An expeditionary corps controls the eastern plateau and the deep-water bay. Break the ridge line, contest the relays and destroy the enemy command post.
meta.author: MCA scenario team

objectives: Capture the signals relays to sustain advanced production.
Seize the forward supply depot in the village for supplementary materials.
Keep your own Command Post operational.
